title: Acceptance under a space bound
statement: Let $N$ be a finite nondeterministic Turing machine with Boolean input and output, let $x$ be a Boolean input, and let $T,s\in\mathbb{N}$. If some choice word of length exactly $T$ makes $N$ halt on $x$ with output $[\mathrm{true}]$, and every choice word of length exactly $T$ uses at most $s$ work-tape cells in total on that input, then some choice word of length exactly $3\bigl(|Q|+1\bigr)(|x|+2)3^{k(2s+1)}(2s+1)^k$ makes $N$ halt on $x$ with output $[\mathrm{true}]$, where $Q$ is the state set and $k$ is the number of work tapes.
hypotheses_covered: $N$ is a finite nondeterministic Turing machine over Boolean symbols
There is an accepting choice word of length exactly $T$
Every choice word of length exactly $T$ uses at most $s$ work-tape cells in total
